name: pinmo
description: Find saved places and import local photo folders into Pinmo as drafts.

interface.shortDescription: Find places and import photos into Pinmo
interface.longDescription: Look up your saved places by city, tag, date, or keyword and review a trip day by day. In a local session on macOS or Windows, authorize folder import to upload resized JPEG copies as draft cards. Open Pinmo to confirm and share them.
defaultPrompt: Where did I go last month?
